title: echinoderm-thesis-pipeline: R workflow for the integrated echinoderm occurrence dataset for northeast Australia and the adjacent Coral Sea
description: R workflow for the integrated echinoderm occurrence dataset for northeast Australia and the adjacent Coral Sea. Produces a curated, quality-controlled Darwin Core Archive of 43,470 occurrence records from 13 source datasets, published through OBIS/ALA/GBIF and described in a Scientific Data Data Descriptor.
